verdict.rationale: Authy's own docs describe an encrypted backup for when you lose your phone, sync across devices, and adding new devices via SMS, voice or existing-device approval, so its tokens can move to a new phone within the app. The docs do not show this as a single guided step: it involves adding the device and then decrypting with a backup password. Community complaints about exporting tokens out of Authy concern leaving the product, not moving to a new phone, so they are not counted here. Missing for 10: documentation of a single guided migration flow, confirmation that all tokens transfer, independent or hands-on corroboration of the new-phone experience.

support.subject: As an everyday user, moving to a new phone transfers all my tokens in one guided step

citations.quote: Use our backup feature incase you lose your phone. We encrypt your data, and only decrypt on the devices using a password only you know.
Add new devices with SMS, voice or existing device approval.
I started using Authy long ago because it supports multiple devices
